The house style keeps the pause form unless an ending must show, and the course already writes عَلَى حَقّ in pause (day 33, grammar card opinion-phrases 'أَظُنُّ أَنَّهُ عَلَى حَقّ', scenario 'أَنْتُمَا عَلَى حَقّ').
